positioning.coreLine: Expanding individual agency through emerging technologies that help people and systems coordinate.

pillars.name: Insight
pillars.copy: AI, blockchain, and spatial computing are changing how we interact with the world around us.

pillars.name: Vision
pillars.copy: A new age of technology should expand human capability and make systems easier to navigate.

pillars.name: Execution
pillars.copy: Bringing that future closer through systems people can use, trust, and build on.

visualSystem.summary: Capital-worthy founder thesis rendered as a quiet technical executive interface.

rules: Use Schibsted Grotesk for display and body.
